voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Arctic Alaska, nineteen thirty-one. A cargo ship was abandoned in the ice. People kept reporting her, drifting and empty, for thirty-eight years.
The Baychimo belonged to the Hudson's Bay Company. Pack ice trapped her that autumn, her hold full of furs.
Most of her crew were flown out. The rest watched from shore as a November blizzard swallowed her.
beats.cap:
MOST OF THE
CREW FLOWN OUT

beats.vo: But hunters and prospectors kept finding her. Some climbed aboard. No one ever brought her in.
The last reported sighting was in nineteen sixty-nine, frozen in the ice. She has never been found.
